user.title: Connect Hospitable
user.description: Enter a Hospitable Personal Access Token from Apps > API access. Public API access requires a paid Hospitable plan; Essentials is excluded. The token needs read access to user, property, reservation, and calendar data.

properties.title: Select properties
properties.description: Choose at least one property to monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Hospitable token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement Personal Access Token for the Hospitable account {account}. Generate one under Apps > API access and confirm the account has paid Public API access.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Hospitable. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Generate a replacement under Apps > API access, and confirm the account has paid Public API access.
error.option_bound: The value is outside the permitted range. Adjust it to within the allowed minimum and maximum, then try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Hospitable account is already configured.
abort.no_properties: No properties were found for this account.
abort.wrong_account: The replacement token belongs to a different account.

init.title: Hospitable options
init.description: Tune polling and property selection. Estimated upstream requests per day: {estimate} (an estimate). Widening the window increases upstream requests per poll; shortening the lookback can hide in-progress long stays and make an occupied property report no reservation.

data.guest_contact_details: Expose guest contact details as entity attributes

data_description.guest_contact_details: Off by default. When enabled, the reservation status entity gains guest_email and guest_phone_numbers attributes, placing the guest's email address and phone number into entity attributes that anyone with access to this Home Assistant instance can read on a dashboard or in a template. Guest names, location, and language are always exposed as attributes; no guest attribute is ever written to the recorder database.
data_description.task_window_days: How many days ahead tasks are fetched, counting from today. Tasks are never fetched backwards. The integration always sends this window explicitly rather than relying on Hospitable's undocumented default, so the task count means the same thing every poll. Hospitable rejects a window ending more than three years ahead.
data_description.task_interval_minutes: How often tasks are polled, in minutes. The minimum accepted value is 5 minutes: a smaller value is rejected, because tasks change far more slowly than the request budget they would consume. Each poll costs one request per selected property, so this multiplies with the number of properties you have selected rather than being a flat cost.
data_description.awaiting_host_reply: Off by default. When enabled, each reservation poll makes one extra API request per property to read that property's message thread, so a 13-property account adds about 13 requests per cycle; the effective rate is held to at most one request per minute per reservation, which deliberately leaves half the upstream allowance free for messages you send yourself. The indicator reports only whether the guest wrote the most recent message. It is NOT a read receipt: the Hospitable API publishes no read state, so this cannot tell whether you or anyone else has already seen a message in the Hospitable web UI, the mobile app, or any other client. Message bodies are never stored as entity attributes and are never logged.

error.reservation_interval_min: The reservation polling interval must be at least 1 minute. Increase the value and try again.
error.property_interval_min: The property polling interval must be at least 15 minutes. Increase the value and try again.
error.lookback_range: The lookback must be between 7 and 365 days. Adjust the value and try again.
error.lookahead_range: The lookahead must be between 1 and 730 days. Adjust the value and try again.
error.invalid_timezone: Timezone overrides must be IANA names such as America/Los_Angeles. Correct the value and try again.
error.task_interval_min: The task polling interval must be at least 5 minutes. Increase the value and try again.
error.task_window_range: The task lookahead window must be between 1 and 730 days. Adjust the value and try again.

forbidden_access.title: Hospitable access was refused
forbidden_access.description: Hospitable refused access to data for account {account}. This is not a token problem, so re-authenticating will not help. Confirm the account plan and permissions include the data this integration reads, then reload the integration.

persistent_failure.title: Hospitable is repeatedly unavailable
persistent_failure.description: The Hospitable integration for account {account} has failed to refresh several times in a row. Check your network connection and the Hospitable status page, then reload the integration once service is restored.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Submits a message to a reservation's guest thread. Hospitable accepts the message for delivery and delivers it asynchronously, so acceptance is not confirmation that the guest has received it.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Hospitable account to use. Required only when more than one account is set up.

entity_id.name: Reservation entity
entity_id.description: A Hospitable entity that identifies the reservation. Give this or a reservation UUID, not both.

reservation_uuid.name: Reservation UUID
reservation_uuid.description: The reservation to message. Give this or a reservation entity, not both.

body.name: Message
body.description: The message text. It is submitted exactly as written.

images.name: Images
images.description: Up to three image URLs to include, each at most 5MB.

sender_id.name: Sender
sender_id.description: The sending identity to use. Accepted only on Airbnb reservations.

get_messages.name: Get messages
get_messages.description: Returns the guest conversation for a reservation. The whole thread is retrieved in one request, so a long conversation arrives in full. Message senders are identified by role only.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Hospitable account to use. Required only when more than one account is set up.

entity_id.name: Reservation entity
entity_id.description: A Hospitable entity that identifies the reservation. Give this or a reservation UUID, not both.

reservation_uuid.name: Reservation UUID
reservation_uuid.description: The reservation whose messages to read. Give this or a reservation entity, not both.

find_reservation.name: Find reservation
find_reservation.description: Returns the details of one reservation. If the reservation cannot be found the result reports that rather than failing. Guest contact details are included only when the guest contact details option is turned on.

config_entry_id.name: Account

entity_id.description: A Hospitable entity that identifies the reservation. Give this or a reservation UUID, not both.

reservation_uuid.name: Reservation UUID
reservation_uuid.description: The reservation to look up. Give this or a reservation entity, not both.

get_reservations.name: Get reservations
get_reservations.description: Returns a property's reservations across the window this account polls. A property this account does not hold is reported as not found, which is a different answer from a property with no bookings.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Hospitable account to use. Required only when more than one account is set up.

property_id.name: Property
property_id.description: The Hospitable property identifier to look up.

get_property_info.name: Get property info
get_property_info.description: Returns a property's details together with its sales channels and their co-hosts, so the identifiers other actions need can be discovered.
